rows.grounds: compound of veda and āhuti; object of dadyāt
repeated noun in apposition with veda+āhutīḥ

items.question: What specific number of Vedic oblations must the officiant offer in this ritual?
premises: The ritual injunction prescribes the giving of oblations.
The oblations in question are designated as Vedic.
The prescribed quantity of these oblations is four.
items.inference: Therefore, the officiant must offer four Vedic oblations.
uncertainties: The precise relation of these four Vedic oblations to the five oblations mentioned in the preceding context is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should give four Vedic oblations.
